title: Rowboat: Local-first AI Agent and Personal Knowledge Graph
summary: Rowboat is a local-first AI assistant that processes digital data like emails and notes to build a living knowledge graph. It stores information in human-readable Markdown files and operates privately on the user's machine.
research_notes: Backed by Y Combinator S24. Founded by the creators of Agara AI (acquired by Coinbase) and emphasizes total data privacy with support for local LLMs via Ollama.

evolution.summary: Pivoted from a developer-focused multi-agent IDE to a consumer-facing local productivity application. It now integrates the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and functions as an autonomous coworker that maintains a persistent context graph.
